\section{\texttt{matches\_metadata\_filters}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.metadata_filters.matches_metadata_filters}\index{Functions!matches\_metadata\_filters}

Match all requested fields using the same semantics for every backend.

\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]

\apifield{Details}Tenant and segment comparisons ignore case. Missing tenant metadata denotes the default tenant; missing or invalid ratings retain the legacy fallback of 5. Date bounds are inclusive, and naive dates are interpreted as UTC. Missing or invalid dates cannot satisfy a date filter.
